test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, PRESENT is written as OQDHFOU and FORCE is written as ENIDF. How will DORMITORY be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/LlhcJX-rTW9F3GmsdQ1rOFm_W353B04aNzD32rBcd-mcX-cmyFKLc1XdfomfCVaKKnT3oEOqwr7yCLGMo-Qav2NJO7-mtG7-_qH_LLPD-MPtAgvCcsGoEWJImwvtZ0JD7Mavz1QZ3ZBvvuOABEg9CA] 

The pattern followed here is:

PRESENT is written as OQDHFOU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a67f3440da530cc000fb31d8baf1057019214f2bcf35d0b9ce3df7df1b2247e7.png] 

And,

FORCE is written as ENIDF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36e4aad9c281148ababebfa180d5bb2bdd034086aef7a0449f6cab5d171f6831.png] 

Similarly,

DORMITORY is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0472b4786f7418258d314f8bfb3f575963922712e7123962db7de74eac269063.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CNQLRUPSZ".**
